mechanism_criteria.selected_event: M-CSA727 proposal1 step1; Asp11 captures phosphoserine phosphoryl group before phosphoenzyme hydrolysis
mechanism_criteria.prediction_target_state: Noncovalent initial phosphoserine reactant, unphosphorylated protein, one Mg
required_Mg_donors: Asp11 carboxyl O different from attacking O
mechanism_criteria.success_scope: Passes selected first-half-reaction heavy-atom organization checks; not full catalytic competence, protonation proof or an associative-versus-dissociative mechanism verdict.

threshold_provenance.attack_distance: Author operational3.5 A inherited from prior phosphoryl screen, not an enzyme-specific experimental cutoff.
threshold_provenance.attack_angle: Author150 degree tolerance around literature-supported inline arrangement, not a measured success boundary.
threshold_provenance.acid_contact: Author3.5 A heavy-atom proximity screen motivated by acid assistance; no hydrogen trajectory inferred.
threshold_provenance.Mg_contact: Author2.8 A upper screen; case protein donor coordinates about1.95-2.25 A and reaction-site topology support it qualitatively, not statistical calibration.
threshold_provenance.Mg_short_contact: Not a pass/fail criterion. Mg is excluded from general by explicit user decision; minimum Mg-O distance is recorded continuously without a hard lower bound.

references.supports: Asp11 phosphoryl attack and Asp13 leaving-group protonation in step1; water attack belongs to step2.
AlF3 analog and reaction-state structures. Not native reactant distance calibration.
Inline arrangement, acid role, Asp11/Asp167 sidechains and Asp13 backbone Mg ligation. Protonation-dependent models; intermediate and TS values not used as reactant cutoffs.

mechanism_criteria.coupling_policy: Enumerate Asp11 OD1/OD2 as attacking O, with the other O as Mg donor; require all checks in one coherent variant. Equivalent oxygens only within their declared chemical groups.
mechanism_criteria.general_separation: Mg count and organization belong to mechanism only; Mg does not affect general. Substrate stereochemistry, pre-existing bond lengths, nonmetal clashes and volume remain general. No forming-pair collision exemption for this case.
mechanism_criteria.decision: User approved evidence/operational-threshold distinction after historical results were available. Not preregistered; fixed before new package replay.

reference_scope: 1L7N is AlF3 TS analog;1L7P is D11N substrate complex without Mg. Neither is the complete native reactant complex.
input_audit_scope: Sequence and stoichiometry checked for all20 current outputs; AF3 declared SMILES checked. No new four-model MSA/template audit.
